title: mri_ca_train
description: Trains GCA data with multiple subjects using provided segmentation volumes and other configuration.

subjects.description: List of subject directories under the SUBJECTS_DIR. Each is a path relative to the subject's MRI directory.
subjects.title: Subjects

segmentation.description: Segmentation volume directory relative to each subject's MRI path.
segmentation.title: Segmentation Volume Directory

transform.description: Atlas transform path relative to each subject's MRI transforms directory.
transform.title: Atlas Transform Path

mask_volume.description: Volume name used as a mask, path relative to each subject's MRI directory.
mask_volume.title: Mask Volume Name

node_spacing.description: Spacing of classifiers in canonical space
node_spacing.title: Node Spacing

prior_spacing.description: Spacing of class priors in canonical space
prior_spacing.title: Prior Spacing

input_training.description: Specifying training data, path relative to each subject's MRI directory. Can specify multiple inputs.
input_training.title: Input Training Data

makesym.description: Symmetrize an already existing atlas. Specify input GCA and symmetrized GCA.
makesym.title: Make Symmetrized GCA

check_symmetry.description: Check the symmetry of an already existing atlas. Specify input GCA and symmetrized GCA.
check_symmetry.title: Check Symmetry

sanity_check.description: Conduct sanity-check of labels for obvious edit errors
sanity_check.title: Sanity Check Flag

threads.description: Specify number of threads to use (also known as -nthreads)
threads.title: Number of Threads
